assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent PNG production paper-doll equipment atlas for a refined Q-style Journey to the West action game.
Primary request: make an ORIGINAL 'Mountain Guardian / Zhenyue' gear family wearable by a heroic Monkey King. It draws only general inspiration from a giant heavenly warrior: dark charcoal iron, warm aged copper trim, thick square silhouettes. This is gear only, NO character or face.
Composition: 3 columns by 3 rows of equal cells, large transparent gutters, every part fully inside its own cell. Exactly 8 separate pieces with real transparent alpha outside, no labels, no grid. Front/three-quarter side viewpoint facing right, consistent upper-left light.
ROW 1 left to right: (1) a low broad open iron war-crown/headband, angular stepped copper brow rim with central square mountain crest, hollow bottom, sized to sit on monkey forehead without hiding eyes, NO head attached; (2) separate sleeveless charcoal iron chest armor with big rectangular copper shoulder rims and a simplified bold mountain crest, dark brick-red scarf above, narrow waist, NO head NO arms NO legs; (3) separate plated skirt armor, three thick charcoal plates, broad copper bands and red sash, slight tiger-fur hem only, NO legs.
ROW 2 left to right: (1) one vertical shoulder-to-elbow piece, squared dark iron pauldron with large copper facet and short golden monkey-fur upper arm underneath, no hand; (2) one vertical forearm bracer, dark iron and copper rectangular guard with golden fur at wrist, no hand; (3) one dark iron boot with copper toe and cuff, right-pointing upturned toe, no leg above.
ROW 3 left to right: (1) small waist pendant: square thick iron mountain seal in copper border with short dark-red knot cord; (2) one long perfectly straight staff VERTICAL, simple charcoal shaft with warm copper bands and thick square block end-caps, equal symmetric ends, ratio about 11:1 length:maximum width, not an axe, no point, NO oversized hammer heads; (3) EMPTY transparent cell.
Style: polished original Q-style Chinese adventure painted illustration, clean dark ink outline, broad two-tone cel-shaded surfaces and readable large highlights, compact bold shapes at tiny gameplay size. Opaque finished painting inside each silhouette. Do not add tiny engraving noise, glowing aura, flames, shadows outside items, background, frame, weapons other than one staff, text or watermark. Eight completely separated equipment parts, not a complete character.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent PNG production paper-doll equipment atlas for a refined Q-style Journey to the West action game.
Primary request: make an ORIGINAL 'Azure Clouds / Qingxiao' gear family wearable by a heroic Monkey King. Graceful jade-green plates, silver edges and small warm gold fittings, bold cloud-scroll motifs. It is distinct from heavy dark iron gear through thinner tapered pieces and flowing curves. Gear only, NO character or face.
Composition: 3 columns by 3 rows of equal cells, large transparent gutters, every part fully inside its own cell. Exactly 8 separate pieces with real transparent alpha outside, no labels or grid. Front/three-quarter side viewpoint facing right, consistent upper-left light.
ROW 1 left to right: (1) a light silver and gold open brow-crown with two gently rising curled cloud crests and ONE central jade lozenge, hollow lower edge, sized to sit on a monkey forehead without hiding eyes, NO head; (2) separate sleeveless jade-green scale chest armor with slender silver rim, bold pale-gold cloud swirl crest and ivory neck scarf, narrow waist, NO head NO arms NO legs; (3) separate light jade-green skirt armor with two tapered overlapping panels, silver/pale gold edging and cream sash, a small tiger-fur hem, NO legs.
ROW 2 left to right: (1) one vertical shoulder-to-elbow piece, small graceful jade pauldron with silver cloud scroll rim and short golden monkey-fur upper arm, no hand; (2) one vertical forearm bracer, jade-green and silver with ONE simple lozenge inlay and golden fur at wrist, no hand; (3) one jade-green boot with thin silver cuff and gold right-pointing upturned toe, no leg above.
ROW 3 left to right: (1) small waist pendant: hollow pale-green jade cloud-loop, silver mount and short cream/gold hanging cord, large readable cloud silhouette; (2) one long perfectly straight staff VERTICAL, deep jade shaft with silver bands and tapered rounded cloud-scroll caps, equal symmetric ends, ratio about 11:1 length:maximum width, blunt ends, not a spear or blade; (3) EMPTY transparent cell.
Style: polished original Q-style Chinese adventure painted illustration, clean dark ink outline, broad two-tone cel shading and readable large highlights, compact shapes at tiny gameplay size. Same heroic warm golden-fur character equipment proportions as a paper-doll Monkey King. Opaque finished painting inside silhouette. No hair or head in crown; no hands, whole character, floating aura, external shadows, background, frame, text, watermark, micro engraving noise or glowing particles. Eight completely separated equipment parts.

processing: Original generated RGBA PNGs copied without pixel edits. Pillow used only for read-only alpha and dimensions inspection. Runtime Canvas crops eight components per sheet and uses source-atop darkening for back-side limbs. Existing r1 bare monkey faces, skeleton, 90x8 staff envelope and all gameplay timings are retained.
sourcePolicy: Original game art generated for this project. No original Journey to the West game assets, external image samples, music or third-party runtime.
